name: bildhaft
description: Turn German sentences into AAC pictograms, correct them, and print them. Runs entirely in the browser.

scripts.test:e2e: node tools/installcheck.mjs && npm run build && playwright test

//playwright: Playwright is bildhaft's own and one minor behind @lautstark/toolchain's ^1.63, which is why playwright.config.ts is written out here rather than extending the shared base. 1.63 ships Chromium 1243, whose renderer dies on this app's METACOM restore - reading a stored FileSystemDirectoryHandle back out of IndexedDB - on main's code as much as on this branch; and the visual baselines beside e2e/visual.spec.ts were recorded against the browser 1.62 ships, so the two have to move together with the baselines re-recorded. adr/0003.
